events.title: 42nd Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony
events.blurb: Portland's official holiday tree is lit at Pioneer Courthouse Square with a community sing-along and a visit from Santa.
events.blurbEs: Se enciende el árbol navideño oficial de Portland en Pioneer Courthouse Square, con canciones para todo el público y la visita de Santa.

events.title: Get A Life Marching Band: Holiday Performances at The Square
events.blurb: An hour of holiday music from the Get A Life Marching Band, part of The Square's free seasonal performance series.
events.blurbEs: Una hora de música navideña con la Get A Life Marching Band, parte de la serie gratuita de presentaciones de temporada en The Square.

events.title: Trail Blazers vs. Warriors
events.addr: 1 N Center Ct St, Portland, OR 97227
events.blurb: The Trail Blazers host Golden State on Black Friday night.
events.blurbEs: Los Trail Blazers reciben a Golden State la noche del Black Friday.

events.title: Trail Blazers vs. Pelicans
events.addr: 1 N Center Ct St, Portland, OR 97227
events.blurb: A Sunday afternoon home game against New Orleans.
events.blurbEs: Partido en casa el domingo por la tarde contra New Orleans.

events.title: ZooLights
events.blurb: The Oregon Zoo's walk-through holiday light display, with a heated, covered area at the Wildlife Pavilion. Tickets include a TriMet ride to and from the zoo that day.
events.blurbEs: El recorrido de luces navideñas del Oregon Zoo, con un área techada y con calefacción en el Wildlife Pavilion. La entrada incluye viaje en TriMet de ida y vuelta al zoológico ese día.
events.getThere: Your ZooLights ticket includes a TriMet ride to and from the zoo on your admission date; the main entrance is near the Washington Park MAX station. Free park-and-ride at Sunset Transit Center, one MAX stop away.

events.title: Oregon Symphony: Music of Hans Zimmer
events.blurb: The Oregon Symphony plays highlights from Hans Zimmer's film scores, including Interstellar, The Lion King and Gladiator. About 1.5 hours with one intermission.
events.blurbEs: La Oregon Symphony interpreta lo mejor de las bandas sonoras de Hans Zimmer, como Interstellar, The Lion King y Gladiator. Dura cerca de hora y media con un intermedio.

events.title: Little Shop of Horrors
events.venue: Portland Center Stage at The Armory
events.blurb: Portland Center Stage's production of the cult musical about a florist and a hungry plant, running through Dec 24. Recommended for middle schoolers and up.
events.blurbEs: Portland Center Stage presenta el musical de culto sobre un florista y una planta hambrienta, en cartelera hasta el 24 de diciembre. Recomendado a partir de secundaria.

events.title: Holiday Bazaar Brewfest
events.blurb: A Small Business Saturday brewfest with 40+ drinks to sample, more than 40 local artisan vendors and live music. Admission ($35 advance, $40 day of) includes 10 tokens and a glass.
events.blurbEs: Un festival de cerveza por el Small Business Saturday con más de 40 bebidas para probar, más de 40 artesanos locales y música en vivo. La entrada ($35 por adelantado, $40 el mismo día) incluye 10 fichas y un vaso.

events.title: Christmas Festival of Lights
events.blurb: The Grotto's holiday light festival opens Friday, with carolers, a puppet show and choir concerts in the Chapel of Mary. Kids 2 and under are free; online tickets are $17.95 for adults and $8.95 for ages 3–11.
events.blurbEs: El festival de luces navideñas de The Grotto abre el viernes, con villancicos, un espectáculo de títeres y conciertos de coros en la Chapel of Mary. Los niños de 2 años o menos entran gratis; en línea, la entrada cuesta $17.95 para adultos y $8.95 para niños de 3 a 11 años.
events.getThere: Entrance at NE 85th & Sandy Blvd. Free parking in the main lot and on nearby streets; on busy nights use the overflow lot at the Parkrose/Sumner Park & Ride, which has a free shuttle. The gate is cash-free.

events.title: Winterhawks vs. Everett Silvertips
events.blurb: Portland's WHL junior hockey team hosts Everett on Saturday night at the Coliseum.
events.blurbEs: El equipo de hockey juvenil de la WHL de Portland recibe a Everett el sábado por la noche en el Coliseum.

events.title: Pittock Mansion: Home for the Holidays
events.blurb: The hilltop mansion is decorated for its 2026 theme, Holidays From Around The World, on view through Jan. 10. Adults $18, youth 6–18 $15, kids under 6 free; advance tickets recommended.
events.blurbEs: La mansión en la colina está decorada con el tema de 2026, Holidays From Around The World, en exhibición hasta el 10 de enero. Adultos $18, jóvenes de 6 a 18 años $15 y menores de 6 gratis; se recomienda comprar con anticipación.
